Card Q&A.q: When a card with a [Main] inherited effect digivolves into a card with the [Flame] or [CS] trait, can I activate this card's [Your Turn] effect and activate that [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a:
After all of BT22-010 [Meramon]'s [Main] effect has resolved, then you process the part of the effect after "if this activated any effect." If you use BT22-010 [Meramon]'s effect to attack, you gain 1 memory after the attack declaration.

Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to activate BT22-010 [Meramon]'s [Main] effect, when do I process the part of the effect after "if this activated any effect"?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If a [Once Per Turn] effect activates, it can't activate again during the same turn.
Card Q&A.q: I used this card's [Your Turn] effect to activate a [Main] [Once Per Turn] effect. Can I activate that [Main] [Once Per Turn] effect again during the same turn?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
